EU.detail: This includes allies. An empty Arctic counts as neutral.

US.detail: All foreign factions count, including allies. An empty theater satisfies this condition.

Chinese military share in the Pacific ≤50%
US.detail: An empty Pacific satisfies this ceiling.

Chinese military share in the Arctic ≥80%

Russia.condition: Russian military share in Eastern Europe ≥99%
Russian military share in the Arctic ≥50%
